name: qwen3vl_8b_thinking_grpo_mixed_lora
_comment_grpo_lora: ABLATION ARM vs. the base config's language-model-only GRPO: target_modules is 'all-linear' here (vision tower + connector ARE trainable), but rank_pattern gives vision-matched layers a much smaller rank (4) than the language model's base rank (16), so vision gets SOME room to adapt without the full blast radius that caused the earlier regression. The regex 'vision|visual' is a STARTING GUESS covering the two known naming conventions (HF's unified '.vision_tower'/'.vision_model' vs Qwen2/2.5-VL's '.visual') -- apply_lora() prints a match-count report at startup (grep logs for '[apply_lora]'); if it says 'matched 0 layers', replace the regex with whatever this model's actual submodule name turns out to be before trusting this run.
